text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali opened summer festival Aoussou in the southern resort of Sousse.
- Tunisia celebrates the 40th anniversary of the republic's proclamation. President Ben Ali is expected to deliver a speech at a ceremony in Carthage Palace.
- Parliament examined law on cooperation accord with Spain to finance development projects in Tunisia.
- Tourism and Handicrafts Minister Slaheddine Maaoui called for best accommodation for tourists to preserve the good results in Tunisia's tourism sector.
